entry.confirm_signal: After the second full-throttle step: one short tone; after the final mid step: four short tones in a row (LED: single flash, long pause).
steps: Transmitter on, ESC unpowered, throttle full.
Connect battery: initialisation tones, then after a short unspecified delay one short tone.
Throttle to mid: one short tone.
Throttle to full: after a short unspecified delay one short tone.
Throttle to mid: four short tones. Programming mode is active.

announce.description: The ESC beeps the setting number, then the value number, and repeats the pair until answered. Example: setting 3 value 2 is 3 beeps then 2 beeps. Values are offered in order from 1; the ESC does not announce the stored value.

select.description: Answer yes with full throttle to store the offered value; the ESC then jumps to the next setting.

skip.description: Answer no with low throttle: the ESC offers the next value of the same setting. No on every value keeps the stored value.

scheme.confirm_signal: Rapid LED flashing and a constant beep after an answer. Return the stick to mid for the next question.
scheme.exit: Power cycle after the last wanted change; the ESC then arms as normal.
scheme.description: Full throttle at power-up, then mid, full, mid enters programming. The ESC asks each value of a setting in turn as setting-number beeps followed by value-number beeps. Full throttle answers yes and stores, low throttle answers no and advances to the next value, mid throttle moves to the next setting after an answer.

unknowns: Beep duration, gap and setting-to-value gap not stated.
Delay between power-up and the first short tone (entry step 2) and between the third and fourth step: only 'a short period of time'.
Time the ESC waits for an answer before repeating or advancing: not stated.
Whether the ESC leaves programming by itself after setting 4: not stated; the manual says to power cycle.
Number of cells, current rating and voltage limits of each model: not stated in these guides.
Pulse width (ms) of the full, mid and low positions the ESC accepts: not stated; the full position can be re-learned by the ESC at power-up.
notes: Castle_Phoenix_Edge.pdf, Castle_Phoenix_Edge_HV.pdf, Castle_Phoenix_Edge_HV_leomotion.pdf (revision 11/2014) and Castle_Phoenix_Edge_qsg.pdf give the same four settings and the same entry sequence.
The quick start guide and the Edge manuals list the same four settings; the quick start guide lists additional defaults (Castle Link only) that stick programming does not reach.
announce.repeat 0 means the sequence repeats until a choice is made (manual: "until answered").
